title: Chapter 2886 - 154: Wujiu Vulture Dragon Pattern
content:
Chapter 2886: Chapter 154: Wujiu Vulture Dragon Pattern

The Wujiu Vulture Dragon Pattern appeared, and instantly a chilling wind howled with authority, accompanied by a terrifying dragon roar echoing in everyone’s ears.

"Dragon!"

Chief Dan Lie and the others changed their colors.

Even Yan Zhu and Qing Zhu showed disbelief, followed by an inexpressible anger in their hearts.

Yan Zhu cursed angrily:

"You, Wujiu Tribe, even dare to steal the Dragon Pattern, desecrating the Royal Court, deserving death!"

The Young Master of Witch Vulture, with a cold face, said indifferently:

"The Dragon Vein of the Great Wilderness resides with those who have virtue, what talk of theft? Since I can bear the Dragon Pattern, it shows the Dragon Vein recognizes me, and I possess the fate of the king’s path. The Divine Dragon has acknowledged my bloodline and descended upon me. As a shaman, what right do you have to interfere?"

Yan Zhu’s expression turned unsightly, and his mind was in turmoil, momentarily speechless with anger.

The dragons of the Great Wilderness only recognize the royal family.

Other barbarian tribes, with inferior bloodlines, could not possibly be tainted by Dragon Blood, Dragon Pattern, or even Dragon Qi, or they would suffer a fatal backlash.

Someone who can engrave a full dragon on themselves, even if not of direct royal lineage, must undoubtedly be a person with the fate of the king’s path.

The Young Master of Wujiu is not wrong.

But precisely because he is not wrong, Yan Zhu is even angrier, and finds it internally unacceptable.

Because this means, in the chaos of the world, the royal authority will fall, the fortunes of the Great Wilderness are disrupted, and the dynasty of the Great Wilderness is likely to change hands.

For Yan Zhu, who serves the deity of the Great Wilderness and the royal family with all his heart, and maintains the rule of the royal family, this is no different from "rebelling against the divine order".

Even Dan Lie and Lugu, along with the chieftains of various major tribes, changed colors and were internally shaken for a moment, unsure of what to do.

The Young Master of Witch Vulture looked down at everyone with an arrogant gaze, speaking in a hoarse yet commanding tone:

"Now that the Dragon Vein has appeared, why not submit? Do you wish to defy the True Dragon of the Great Wilderness?"

Silence reigned around, the atmosphere was extremely tense, and a group of great chieftains frowned, no one dared to respond, nor took any action.

A moment later, Dan Lie, the "Alliance Hierarch", sneered coldly:

"What True Dragon? Laughable. Merely a ’Wicked Dragon’ cobbled together with scribbles, daring to impersonate the True Dragon of the Great Wilderness, swaggering and deceiving here?"

Yan Zhu’s eyes flashed, regained his composure, and followed with a cold laugh:

"Indeed, as a shaman, I have served the Royal Court for years and never have I seen such a black and wicked dragon as you have. This dragon is not legitimate, just your Wujiu Tribe’s deceitful ploy to bewitch the masses and deceive others."

Yan Zhu’s eyes steeled, affirming word by word: "You secretly painted the Dragon Pattern, and rebelled against the Royal Court, a crime punishable by death!"

With these words, everyone agreed.

"Painting the Dragon Pattern in secret, a crime punishable by death!"

"Rebellion against the Royal Court, the entire tribe must be eradicated!"

Filled with righteous indignation, the Great Chief of the Flame Wing Tribe immediately charged at the Young Master of Witch Vulture, shouting angrily:

"Traitor, prepare to die!"

Dan Lie, Lugu, and other great chieftains also acted decisively, quickly taking action, intending to kill the Young Master of Witch Vulture with a thunderous force.

To eliminate this great hidden threat of the "Dragon Pattern" right here.

The Great Wilderness must not have another dragon!

Seeing everyone converging to attack, the Young Master of Witch Vulture maintained a calm countenance, then smiled rather than being angry, coldly saying:

"A bunch of lowly fools, failing to appreciate—since you seek death, I’ll grant it for you..."

The Young Master of Witch Vulture gently unfolded his arms, and the Dragon Pattern on his body seemed to come alive, like a dragon serpent ready to devour, with a fierce aura filling his flesh.

"I’ll show you what a True Dragon is, what Bloodline Power is..."

With the sound of a peculiar dragon roar, the Young Master of Witch Vulture’s entire body inflated a circle.

The Dragon Pattern moved on his body, dragon scales covered his entire frame.

His eyes, lips, all turned pitch black, and his pupils became beast-like vertical slits, glinting with a terrifying crimson glow.

He appeared as if a "Black Dragon Young Master".

Even with only Golden Core Middle Stage cultivation, just his presence was enough to make hearts tremble.

Dan Lie and other great chieftains could only brace themselves, driven by various barbarian tribe magic treasures, attempting to kill the Young Master of Witch Vulture.

Both sides engaged in a deadly battle.

But this "Half Dragon-Transformed" Young Master of Witch Vulture, his body was incomparably mighty, the scale armor around him was impenetrable.

This level of defense allowed him to effortlessly withstand the killing strikes from a group of Golden Core Late Stage great chieftains, fighting without restraint.

And with the support of the Dragon Pattern, almost every punch from the Young Master of Witch Vulture carried a rolling dragon’s roar, contained the unmatched Witch Dragon Power, wounding anything it touched.

With slight carelessness, if struck by the Dragon Strength entering the body, one’s bloodline and bones would be torn by the Evil Dragon, leaving incurable severe injuries.

It was both offensive and defensive. Defensively, dragon scales protected, leaving no breach; offensively, dragon strength entwined, like a storm.

In the melee, almost no great chief could face the Young Master of Witch Vulture and endure for over a hundred rounds.

Lugu was no match for the Young Master of Witch Vulture.

And this was despite the fact that these great chieftains had a cultivation advantage over the Young Master of Witch Vulture by one Golden Core minor realm.

The terror of the Dragon Pattern Bloodline’s might is thus.

Seeing this situation, those around were all shocked and changed colors.

In the distance, thousands of Vermilion Bird Division barbarian soldiers, deterred by the Young Master of Wujiu’s power, turned pale, their military spirit wavering.

While the army of the Wujiu Tribe’s morale soared, chanting the name of their young master, the cries resounded throughout the entire Vermilion Bird Mountain Range.

The situation took a dramatic turn for the worse.

No one could turn the tide.

The Young Master of Witch Vulture, with his strength alone, suppressed several tribal great chieftains.

This was not merely suppression in strength but also an overwhelming supremacy in bloodline, an intimidation of dragon might.

The allied great chieftains couldn’t long battle the "Dragon-Transformed" Young Master of Witch Vulture; otherwise, not only would they suffer heavy injuries from dragon strength invading their bodies, but the fear within their bloodlines towards the dragon, the submission towards the "king," was also deepening constantly.
